title: Exactly one trailing dot is stripped, never all of them
description: The case the `pnpm fuzz` gate and the implementation disagreed about for two sessions (PLAN.md O62). `normalizePolicyHost` removes **one** trailing dot, so `a.test..` becomes `a.test.` and not `a.test`; the gate asserted the output was a fixed point, which this input disproves. Pinned here because that disagreement was only visible on a wall-clock-seeded fuzz run, and because the two languages must agree on a value neither of them reaches through a normal request. Not an allowlist bypass in either direction: a pattern receives the same normalization, so `a.test..` matches the pattern `a.test..` and not the pattern `a.test`.
